EmailTemplate.subject: AVAILABLE NOW: New Dashboard Option
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Introducing our new improved dashboard! Same information. Enhanced functionality. More intuitive design. All the product capabilities you know and love in an easy-to-use format.
Starting today, you now have the option to access all of your cross-border international payment information in a more intuitive format. Our new improved dashboard features the following enhanced functionality:
- High-level reporting
- Enhanced user management
- Better refund experience
- Activity log drill down
You will have the ability to move between your new and existing dashboards for the next few months. Click here <[[https://dashboard-new.flywire.com/learn-more?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> to learn more. If you have any questions, please contact your relationship manager.
